name: memory
description: Configurable memory layer for RAG: chunk/search/embed with built-in hash embedder (offline, zero deps). Actions: chunk {text,size,overlap}, embed {texts[] or text,dim}, search {query,top_k,threshold,dim,collection_ids,mode}. If action is omitted it is inferred: query -> search, texts -> embed, text -> chunk, else search. Vector: builtin hash+cosine default, muninndb/sqlite-vec swappable; embeddings: builtin / openai_compat via providers base_url / local_onnx stub.
llm_description: RAG memory: action chunk {text,size,overlap}, embed {texts[] or text,dim}, or search {query,top_k,threshold,dim,collection_ids,mode: vector (default) or keyword}. Omit action to infer: query->search, texts->embed, text->chunk. Offline hash embedder by default; vector store and embeddings backend are swappable (muninndb/sqlite-vec, openai_compat, local_onnx).

action.description: chunk, search, or embed. If omitted: search when query is set, embed when texts is set, chunk when text is set.

size.description: Maximum bytes per chunk (default 800). Values above 800 are capped by the guest.

overlap.description: Bytes of overlap between chunks (default 120). Values above 120 are capped by the guest.

dim.description: Embedding dimensions (default 128). Values are clamped to 16-1024 by the guest.
